description:
A Twitch channel's most viewed clips for a period (last day, week, month or all time, up to 50) with views, duration, creator, game and the source VOD timestamp.
Cost: 1 credit per successful call (failed calls are refunded).
Returns: user_id (string, nullable), username (string), display_name (string), period (string), clips (array<object>), clips_fetched (integer), has_more (boolean).

limit.description: Maximum number of clips to return. Example: 20

period.description: Time window: last_day, last_week, last_month or all_time. Example: "last_week"

username.description: Twitch login name or channel URL. Example: "shroud"

name: twitch_clips
title: Twitch clips
